description: Private, practical help with benefits, the council, the NHS, letters and forms. Based in Norwich, helping people across Norfolk.
content:
Norwich · Norfolk

Life in the UK, made clear.

We help newcomers with benefits, the council, the NHS and official letters. Calm, private help in simple words.

Book a consultation
See all services

Why we exist

A letter you cannot read. A form that asks the same thing twice. A phone line that never answers.

Starting a life in a new country is hard enough. We sit with you, explain what each paper means and help you take the next step. One person, one problem at a time.

What we help with

Practical help with the offices of everyday life.

Choose a topic to see what we can do. If your problem is not on the list, ask us anyway.

Benefits and Universal Credit. Understand what you may be able to claim and keep your claim in order.
  • We explain the benefits you may be able to claim and what they depend on.
  • Help to set up and use your online account.
  • Help with forms, messages and evidence the office asks for.
  • Help to understand a decision letter and what you can do next.
Council and housing. Council tax, housing applications and letters from the council.
  • We read council letters with you and explain what they ask for.
  • Help with council tax bills, discounts and payment plans.
  • Help to apply for housing and keep your application up to date.
  • Help to reply before the deadline.
GP, NHS and health. Register with a doctor and understand NHS letters.
  • Help to find a GP surgery near you and register.
  • We explain NHS letters and appointment details.
  • We explain when to use NHS 111 and when to call 999.
Work and money basics. National Insurance number, bank account, payslips and school places.
  • Help to apply for a National Insurance number.
  • We explain your payslip and the main deductions.
  • Help with the papers a bank may ask for.
  • Help to apply for a school place for your child.
Letters, forms and emails. Bring us the letter. We read it with you and help you reply.
  • We read official letters with you and explain them in simple words.
  • Help to fill in forms correctly the first time.
  • Help to write clear replies and emails.
  • We help you keep your papers in order, so nothing gets lost.
Appointments and phone calls. Get ready for an appointment and make the call with support.
  • We help you prepare questions and papers before an appointment.
  • With your permission, we can speak to an office for you.
  • We write down what was agreed, so you have a record.
Legal problems and immigration. We help you find the right regulated adviser or solicitor.
  • We do not give immigration advice. For visas, status and asylum you need a regulated adviser or a solicitor.
  • We help you find a regulated adviser or solicitor, including free services where they exist.
  • We help you put your papers in order before your meeting.
  • For other legal problems we explain where to get proper legal help.

See all services

How it works

Four simple steps.

  1. Send a message. Use WhatsApp, phone or email. Tell us your name, your language and a few words about the problem.
  2. We talk. We listen, look at your papers and tell you what we can do. You know the cost before any work starts.
  3. We do the work together. Letters, forms, calls and online accounts. We explain every step as we go.
  4. You stay in control. Nothing is sent or signed without your OK. You keep copies of everything.
How it works

Our promise

How we work with you.

Simple words

No jargon. We explain things slowly and check that you understand before we move on.

Private

What you tell us stays with us. We only share it when you say yes, or when the law says we must.

Honest about limits

If you need a solicitor or a regulated immigration adviser, we tell you straight away and help you find one.

Local

We are based in Norwich. We know the city and the county, and the offices people deal with every day.

Six languages

Read this website in the language you know best.

Every page is in English, Bulgarian, Romanian, Turkish and two forms of Kurdish. When you contact us, tell us which language you speak.

  • Hoş geldiniz · Türkçe

  • بەخێربێن · کوردی (سۆرانی)

Questions

People often ask.

Do you give immigration advice?

No. In the UK only regulated advisers and solicitors can give immigration advice. We can help you find one and help you get your papers ready for the meeting.

Are you a law firm?

No. Advice4you is not a law firm and we are not solicitors. If your problem needs a lawyer, we will tell you and help you find the right one.

Which languages can I use?

This website is in English, Bulgarian, Romanian, Turkish and Kurdish (Kurmanji and Sorani). When you contact us, tell us which language you speak and we will tell you how we can help.

How much does it cost?

Contacting us is free. Before we start any paid work, we tell you the price and what it includes. There are no hidden costs.
